text.arabic_uthmani: أَمْ حَسِبَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱجْتَرَحُوا۟ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ أَن نَّجْعَلَهُمْ كَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ سَوَآءًۭ مَّحْيَاهُمْ وَمَمَاتُهُمْ ۚ سَآءَ مَا يَحْكُمُونَ

words.gloss_range: disconnected interrogative particle opening a rebuking alternative over the whole supposition
words.prose: {{ar:أَمْ}} ({{tr:am}}) launches the ayah as a rebuking alternative rather than a neutral continuation. Its scope reaches the whole proposed equality, so the reader first hears the entire worldview put under challenge. The clipped onset also marks the boundary shift from offered insight into adversarial testing.

topics.headline: rebuking particle scopes over the whole supposition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah challenges an entire proposed moral equivalence, not only one following verb.
topics.reason: The particle opens the main challenge and attachment evidence places the following content clause inside that challenged supposition.

topics.headline: boundary turn from insight to challenge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the ayah change register at the first particle, moving from prior guidance into direct testing.
topics.reason: The boundary rows and sound row both describe the same opening modulation; nothing in local grammar blocks it.

words.gloss_range: reckoning or supposing verb governing a concrete content clause about divine making and equality
words.root_gloss_range: reckoning, counting, accounting, supposing, and sufficiency; locally the supposition/accounting branch governs the equality proposition
words.prose: {{ar:حَسِبَ}} ({{tr:ḥasiba}}) makes the false equality a reckoned proposition, not a stray wish. The verb governs the later making clause and lets the whole comparison unfold as the content of defective calculation: acquired harm and worked repair are treated as if they could sit in the same account. The same opening formula rebukes presumed escape in (29:4); here the fantasy is equivalence. Its reckoning field then answers the closing judgment: the ayah begins with miscalculation and ends by condemning how they judge.

topics.headline: reckoning governs the projected making clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader waits for the content of the supposition and recognizes it as a full theory of divine making.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the relative group the subject and the content clause the complement of the reckoning verb.

topics.headline: accounting field turns supposition into moral calculation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the error as a moral calculation, while the local verb still means supposing or reckoning rather than literal arithmetic.
topics.reason: The root field supports accounting pressure, and the opening formula also rebukes false inference in (29:4), but local grammar selects supposition over a numerical account.

topics.headline: opening reckoning frames the closing judgment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the ayah as an arc from defective cognition to condemned judgment.
topics.reason: The boundary and echo rows converge with the final judgment verb, making cognition accountable across the whole ayah.

words.gloss_range: masculine plural relative pronoun defining the first group by its following deed clause
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhīna}}) withholds a label until the deed clause supplies one. The group is identified through conduct, so the comparison is moral from its first class-marker. The later repeated relative form creates comparability without erasing the different predicates.

topics.headline: relative pronoun builds a conduct-defined class
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the first group is grammatically named by what it has done, not by inherited status or a bare label.
topics.reason: The relative pronoun is the subject group of the reckoning verb and is completed by the following deed clause.

words.gloss_range: Form VIII completed plural perpetration/acquisition of bad deeds, with wound-image pressure kept local
words.root_gloss_range: cutting, wounding, injury, hunting-acquisition, and committed earning; locally Form VIII selects self-involved moral acquisition of bad deeds
words.prose: {{ar:ٱجْتَرَحُوا۟}} ({{tr:ijtaraḥū}}) makes the first class a completed action-profile. Its direct object fixes what was acquired as bad deeds, while the rare wound-root pressure makes that acquisition feel damaging and self-involved. The rarity and hunting-acquisition echo at (5:4) sharpen the image without replacing the local sense of committing or earning bad acts.

topics.headline: completed plural verb takes bad deeds as object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the group defined by completed perpetration with a concrete object, not vague guilt.
topics.reason: The verb agrees with the relative head and takes the bad-deed noun as its explicit object.

topics.headline: wound-root pressure colors moral acquisition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the deeds as harm acquired by the actors themselves, while local grammar keeps the sense within committed bad action.
topics.reason: Form VIII and the object select acquired perpetration; concrete wounding remains image-pressure rather than the local action itself.

topics.headline: rare verb contrasts wound-like acquisition with sound action
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices why this rare verb matters: it sets a wound-like negative profile against the later worked repair.
topics.reason: The occurrence and echo rows make the rare root salient, including the acquisition image in (5:4), and the local ayah later balances it with worked sound deeds.

words.gloss_range: definite plural bad deeds as the object acquired by the first group and the negative pole of the comparison
words.root_gloss_range: badness, evil, harm, ugliness, grief, and exposed fault; locally the noun denotes recognized bad deeds and their harmful moral quality
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ}} ({{tr:al-sayyiʾāti}}) names the acquired object as a known class of bad deeds, widening the object from rule-breaking into harmful moral deformation. The definite feminine plural mirrors the later sound-deed object while reversing its value, so the comparison is built on opposed moral records before equality is ever named. The same badness field returns in the closing blame verb, and the sound pattern brushes the equality word before censure, making the verdict answer the opening deed-profile.

topics.headline: definite plural object anchors acquired bad deeds
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees exactly what the first group acquired: a recognized class of bad acts.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence confirms the noun as the explicit object of the preceding verb.

topics.headline: badness root forms the negative pole and returns at verdict
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears badness move from deed-object to closing judgment, so the end exposes the beginning.
topics.reason: The root field supports harm and ugliness locally, the contrast with sound deeds is explicit, and the same badness field is echoed at the closing verdict; the moral-return contrast also fits (17:7).

words.gloss_range: subordinating particle turning the proposed making into the content of the reckoning
words.prose: {{ar:أَن}} ({{tr:an}}) is the hinge from the act of reckoning to the proposition being reckoned. It packages the divine making clause as the content under challenge while keeping the following imperfect projected rather than completed. Even its tight sound-link to the next verb helps the content clause arrive as one compressed unit.

topics.headline: subordinator packages proposed making as reckoned content
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the false equality becoming a subordinate thought-object before it is rejected.
topics.reason: The particle introduces the content complement governed by the reckoning verb and binds directly to the following imperfect.

words.gloss_range: projected first-person plural making/rendering verb with offenders as object and comparison/equality as complement
words.root_gloss_range: making, placing, appointing, rendering, assigning, and classifying; locally the verb projects an alleged divine assignment of the offenders into parity
words.prose: {{ar:نَّجْعَلَهُمْ}} ({{tr:najʿalahum}}) puts the imagined equality under divine making: the offenders are the object of a proposed assignment. The imperfect after the subordinator keeps that assignment projected inside their supposition, not stated as reality. The root's rendering and classifying range makes the denied claim sharper: they imagine a divine act that would assign unlike groups to the same outcome.

topics.headline: projected divine making with object and comparison complement
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the central false proposition as an alleged act of divine making, not a free-floating comparison.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence confirms the object suffix and comparison complement, while the subordinator projects the imperfect inside the supposition.

topics.headline: making field frames equality as assigned classification
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the false equality would have to be assigned or rendered, while the local clause keeps this as their challenged supposition.
topics.reason: The root field licenses rendering and assigning pressure, and the local equality noun supplies the result, but the whole claim remains embedded under reckoning.

words.gloss_range: prefixed comparison marker proposing likeness between the two relative groups
words.prose: {{ar:كَ}} ({{tr:ka}}) is the comparison hinge: it attaches the second relative group to the proposed making. The likeness marker is dependent and does not by itself prove full identity; the later equality word exposes how far the proposed analogy is being pushed. Its tight fusion with the following relative form makes the comparator enter as one unit.

topics.headline: comparison marker sets up the false analogy
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the exact point where the supposition turns into analogy between two moral classes.
topics.reason: The prefixed preposition governs the second relative group as the comparison complement of the making verb.

words.gloss_range: second masculine plural relative pronoun, governed by the comparison marker and defined by faith plus action
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhīna}}) supplies the comparator class under the comparison marker. Like the first relative, it waits for predicates to define the group, but here those predicates are faith and sound action. The mirrored form lets the two groups be compared grammatically while their moral profiles stay distinct.

topics.headline: second relative defines the comparator by faith and action
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the positive group introduced with matching grammar but completed by a different moral profile.
topics.reason: The relative pronoun is governed by the comparison marker and heads the second relative clause.

words.gloss_range: Form IV plural faith/trust profile, objectless here and paired with sound action
words.root_gloss_range: security, trust, faith, safety, and entrusted reliability; locally Form IV denotes the faith profile that precedes worked sound deeds
words.prose: {{ar:ءَامَنُوا۟}} ({{tr:āmanū}}) opens the positive comparator with a completed plural faith-profile. Because no explicit object is stated, the wording presents faith as the group's defining trust-orientation, with secure fidelity and entrusted reliability in the background, before worked deeds complete the profile. The familiar faith-and-deeds pairing, echoed in promise language such as (2:25) and answered again in this surah at (45:30), makes the comparator more than a generic moral opposite.

topics.headline: objectless plural faith defines the comparator
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices faith as a group profile awaiting its action complement, not as an isolated inward label.
topics.reason: The relative head supplies the plural subject, and no explicit object narrows the faith verb inside this clause.

topics.headline: security and entrusted reliability color faith
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels faith as trust and secure fidelity, while local grammar keeps belief/faith as the selected sense.
topics.reason: The root family supports security and trust pressure, but the local Form IV faith verb remains the governing sense.

topics.headline: faith-and-deeds formula locates the comparator in promise language
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the comparator as the familiar faith-and-sound-deeds profile that the false equality tries to flatten.
topics.reason: The rows point to the recurrent faith-and-deeds formula, including (2:25), and the same-surah answer at (45:30).

words.gloss_range: coordinating conjunction joining faith and action inside one relative identity
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) makes faith and worked soundness co-present inside one class description. It does not let faith collapse into action or action stand apart from faith; the two predicates jointly complete the comparator. The repeated plural cadence across the joined verbs reinforces the paired profile.

topics.headline: conjunction joins predicates into one full profile
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the comparator is defined by faith with action, not by one element alone.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence confirms coordination of the two predicates within the same relative clause.

words.gloss_range: completed plural doing/working verb taking sound deeds as its explicit object
words.root_gloss_range: doing, working, acting, producing, and deed-record; locally the verb denotes worked action whose object is sound deeds
words.prose: {{ar:عَمِلُوا۟}} ({{tr:ʿamilū}}) turns the faith-profile into produced action. Its direct object prevents the action from remaining vague: what is worked is the class of sound deeds. The paired plural cadence moves from faith through action into the longer sound-deed object. Against the earlier wound-like acquisition, this ordinary doing becomes the positive action-record, with accountability echoes such as (99:7-8) sharpening the deed scale.

topics.headline: worked action takes sound deeds as object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the positive group completed by concrete worked output, not only by belief.
topics.reason: The verb is coordinated with faith and takes the following sound-deed noun as its object.

topics.headline: work-root makes deeds a produced record against acquired harm
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices an action antithesis: wound-like acquisition on one side, worked repair on the other.
topics.reason: The root field supports doing and produced record, and the rows connect it to the earlier acquisition verb and deed accountability, including (99:7-8) and same-surah accountability at (45:15).

topics.headline: cadence carries the positive profile toward its object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the positive profile move from faith through action into the long sound-deed object.
topics.reason: The cadence and boundary rows add surface force to the same faith-action profile without changing the local syntax.

words.gloss_range: definite plural sound/restorative deeds as the explicit object completing the positive profile
words.root_gloss_range: soundness, repair, restoration, fitness, and righteousness; locally the active-participle noun denotes recognized sound deeds
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ}} ({{tr:al-ṣāliḥāti}}) completes the comparator by naming the worked object as recognized sound deeds. Its plural form mirrors the earlier bad-deed object while reversing value, so the ayah sets repair against harm before denying parity. The familiar formula in (2:82) and the same-surah answer at (45:30) keep this object tied to promise and outcome language.

topics.headline: definite plural object completes the positive profile
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the positive group specified by a known class of sound deeds, not generic goodness.
topics.reason: The noun is the explicit object of the worked-action verb and closes the comparator profile.

topics.headline: repair field mirrors and reverses bad deeds
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the contrast as repair versus harm, not merely good versus bad labels.
topics.reason: The root field supports soundness and repair, and the local feminine plural mirrors the bad-deed object while reversing its value.

topics.headline: sound-deeds formula links comparator to promise language
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the comparator as the standard faith-and-sound-deeds profile that the ayah refuses to level.
topics.reason: The rows tie the object to recurrent faith-and-deeds formulae, including (2:82), and to the same-surah answer at (45:30).

words.gloss_range: abstract equality/parity term marking the alleged result or state, pivoting the comparison into life-and-death scope
words.root_gloss_range: evenness, leveling, equality, straightness, and becoming alike; locally the noun names the false parity being tested
words.prose: {{ar:سَوَآءًۭ}} ({{tr:sawāʾan}}) is the word where the proposed likeness becomes explicit parity. Its accusative form marks equality as a state or result of the imagined making, while the accepted nominative variant tests a predicative relation without changing the local issue: parity is the claim under judgment. Here equality is a false measure of opposed deed-poles, and the hamza catch makes the text pause on the leveling word before it extends to life and death. The word then pivots from comparing groups to measuring their life and death as a total span.

topics.headline: case-sensitive equality term bears syntactic weight
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that equality is grammatically loaded, with case variation testing how the parity attaches.
topics.reason: The local accusative supports state/result syntax, while the accepted nominative variant highlights predicative pressure without replacing the canonical surface.

topics.headline: leveling root names the rejected parity of unlike classes
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels equality here as a mismeasurement that tries to level unlike moral realities.
topics.reason: The equality root and making root converge on assigned parity, while unequal-pair passages such as (13:16) show the broader denial pattern.

topics.headline: equality pivots into life-and-death totality
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the equality claim expand from group comparison into the whole life-death span.
topics.reason: The following coordinated life and death nouns define the scope over which equality is being tested.

words.gloss_range: possessed life-course within the equality phrase, paired with death as an existential span
words.root_gloss_range: life, living, vitality, animation, and related associations such as modesty/greeting in other branches; locally the mīm-form denotes life-course or mode of living
words.prose: {{ar:مَّحْيَاهُمْ}} ({{tr:maḥyāhum}}) moves the equality claim into lived span. The possessive suffix attaches life-course to the evaluated groups, and the matched mīm-form prepares the death term that completes the pair. The rare form and the life-death formula, including (6:162), make the issue more than status: the false parity reaches into how life itself is measured.

topics.headline: possessed mīm-form marks life-course under equality
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices life as an owned course or mode, not only biological existence in the abstract.
topics.reason: The noun participates in the equality phrase, and the suffix attaches the life-course to the compared groups.

topics.headline: life-root and rare form widen the stakes of parity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the parity claim reaching lived vitality, while disputed or secondary life-root associations remain background pressure.
topics.reason: The local mīm-form selects life-course; modesty and derivational-dispute rows are retained only as root-association pressure.

topics.headline: life term opens the meristic life-death totality
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees life and death as a totalizing pair under the denied equality.
topics.reason: The rows connect the pair locally and to total-life formulae such as (6:162), while same-surah slogans at (45:24) make the life-death issue prominent.

words.gloss_range: coordinating conjunction joining death to life under the same equality frame
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) binds death into the same equality frame already opened by life. The conjunction makes the two nouns a totalizing pair rather than two separate examples. Its sound-link into the following mīm-form helps the equality phrase move from lived course to endpoint without a break.

topics.headline: conjunction makes life and death one meristic pair
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that death is not appended loosely; it is coordinated under the same parity claim as life.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence confirms the death noun is coordinated with the life noun inside the equality phrase.

words.gloss_range: possessed death endpoint coordinated with life, closing the equality span before censure
words.root_gloss_range: death, dying, lifelessness, stillness, and cessation; locally the mīm-form denotes the death endpoint/state paired with life-course
words.prose: {{ar:مَمَاتُهُمْ}} ({{tr:mamātuhum}}) closes the life-death pair and therefore the scope of the alleged parity. The suffix makes the endpoint belong to the evaluated groups, and the matched mīm-form answers the life term with a heavier terminal force. The accepted accusative variant tightens the state-syntax pressure, but the local payoff is the same: the false equality tries to include death as well as life.

topics.headline: possessed death noun closes the equality phrase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees death as the determinate endpoint of the parity claim, not a loose afterthought.
topics.reason: The noun is coordinated with the life term and closes the equality phrase before the censure clause.

topics.headline: rare mīm-form and accusative variant mark death as endpoint state
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices form-level pressure around death as endpoint, while the local coordination keeps it paired with life.
topics.reason: The canonical form is coordinated in the equality phrase; the accepted accusative variant sharpens state syntax without overriding the local pair.

topics.headline: death completes the dominant life-death field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the denied equality stretching to the full life-death distribution.
topics.reason: The root field supplies endpoint and stillness pressure, and life-death cooccurrence rows, including (2:258), reinforce the total span.

words.gloss_range: perfect blame verb of badness/dispraise introducing the verdict on their judgment
words.root_gloss_range: badness, evil, harm, ugliness, grief, and disgrace; locally the Form I blame verb condemns the judging itself as bad
words.prose: {{ar:سَآءَ}} ({{tr:sāʾa}}) turns from the proposed equality to verdict. As a perfect blame verb, it states the censure as settled while the following judgment remains ongoing. The badness field returns from the earlier bad-deed object to judge the act of judging itself, so their verdict is not a neutral mistake but a morally corrupt ruling. The sharp hamza gives the censure an audible catch, and the later exposure of bad deeds at (45:33) makes this bad judgment a preview as well as a close.

topics.headline: perfect blame verb governs the following judgment clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears a completed verdict fall on the evaluators after their equality claim is exposed.
topics.reason: The verb functions as dispraise, with the following clause supplying what is condemned.

topics.headline: badness moves from deeds to judgment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same badness field that named deeds now names the quality of their ruling.
topics.reason: The root recurrence links the early bad-deed object to the closing blame verb, and the destination formula at (4:97) supports the verdict force without changing the local object.

topics.headline: sound and scene shift mark formal condemnation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the sentence cross from exposing a supposition into formal condemnation.
topics.reason: The cadence and boundary rows reinforce the closing verdict, including the same-surah exposure of bad deeds at (45:33).

words.gloss_range: relative or specifying particle packaging the ongoing judging as what is condemned
words.prose: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) prevents the blame verb from remaining a bare exclamation. It packages the following judging into the condemned object, whether heard relatively as what they judge or specifying how vile the judgment is. The small hinge therefore lets censure and explanation arrive together.

topics.headline: particle packages judging as the blamed object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final censure targets the judging process itself, not only an unstated object.
topics.reason: The particle after the blame verb introduces the content that is condemned and supports relative or specifying parsing.

words.gloss_range: imperfect plural judging/ruling verb closing the ayah on their ongoing evaluative process
words.root_gloss_range: judging, ruling, deciding, restraining, governance, and wisdom; locally the verb denotes their defective ongoing judgment
words.prose: {{ar:يَحْكُمُونَ}} ({{tr:yaḥkumūn}}) leaves the ayah on the offenders' ongoing act of judgment. The long plural ending keeps the judges audible at the terminal point rather than letting the ayah end on abstract equality. The imperfect and omitted object broaden the indictment from one proposition to a defective evaluative habit. Its root field of ruling, restraint, and wisdom makes the failure deeper: they attempt to govern moral outcome by a judgment that the ayah has already condemned.

topics.headline: imperfect objectless verb broadens the indictment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final word condemns an ongoing mode of judgment, not a single past mistake.
topics.reason: The verb is imperfect plural and closes the explanatory clause with no explicit object, broadening the censure.

topics.headline: judging root contrasts defective ruling with wisdom and restraint
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels their error as failed ruling and failed restraint, while the local verb remains ordinary judging.
topics.reason: The root field supports ruling, restraint, and wisdom pressure; references such as (95:8), (45:16), and (45:37) frame human judging under divine wisdom without replacing the local verb sense.

topics.headline: final cadence leaves the judges audibly exposed
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the ayah end on the plural judging agents rather than on abstract equality.
topics.reason: The cadence and boundary rows show the prior guidance frame answered by defective evaluation at the close.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus compares people who acquired evil with people marked by trust and beneficial action, tests equality across living and dying, and condemns the resulting judgment.
baseline_models.mechanism: A supposition performs a classification: deliberately acquired conduct distinguishes two cohorts, while making and equality ask whether they can be assigned one condition. The closing judgment rejects that projected parity.

activation_trace.role: A mental estimate short of certainty supplies the projected parity that the question exposes.
Deliberate acquisition of action supplies the conduct that differentiates the compared people.
Assignment to a state or rank turns likeness into an appointed condition rather than a casual resemblance.
Heart-set assent supplies the inward orientation of one cohort.
Purposive action makes the comparison behavioral as well as confessional.
Repair opposed to corruption gives the good actions a restorative direction.
Equivalence between two things is the precise relation placed under denial.
Adjudication supplies the decision function whose result is condemned.

changed_reading.before: The verse merely says that bad people and believers are not the same.
changed_reading.after: The verse stages a disputed classification: acquired conduct is evidence, appointed condition is the issue, and the condemned judgment projects one parity across unlike moral trajectories.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Counting, acquisition, work, equivalence, and adjudication form a focus-internal vocabulary of valuation.
baseline_models.mechanism: The sentence can operate like an audit. Evil is acquired, good is worked, equality is a proposed valuation, and judgment rules on whether unlike entries receive the same assessment. The problem is not only wickedness but a defective metric.

activation_trace.role: Counting and reckoning supply the audit operation behind the subjects' estimate.
Acquisition supplies negative entries generated by the agents themselves.
A stipulated return for work contributes the exploratory image of an assigned payout.
The worker's due contributes an economic edge to the good cohort's action.
Equal value or measure supplies the contested result of the audit.
Legal assessment supplies an authoritative test of the proposed valuation.
Formulaic blame marks the calculation itself as a bad result.

changed_reading.before: The question contrasts two moral labels.
changed_reading.after: The question audits a proposed equivalence: the labels contain acquired and worked entries, and the final clause indicts the measure that prices them alike.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The equality term directly governs a paired reference to the compared people's living and dying.
baseline_models.mechanism: Living and dying can be heard as qualitative states rather than bare biological events. The focus therefore denies a flattening that may range over both phases, while leaving live whether the cohorts are compared phase by phase or whether life and death have been collapsed into one value.

activation_trace.role: Equivalence supplies the predicate whose syntactic range across the two phases remains open.
Life as benefit and good makes living a morally textured condition, not only animation.
A mode or quality of dying makes death a differentiated condition as well as an endpoint.
Assignment to a condition links both phases to the disputed divine making.

changed_reading.before: Only the groups' final destinations differ.
changed_reading.after: The denied parity can encompass the moral quality and yield of both living and dying; the syntax still permits a phase-by-phase group comparison and a critique of flattening life and death into one horizon.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening joins a delivered book to exact wisdom. Its branches activate proper placement and binding inscription, so the focus's disputed making becomes an official classification and the subjects' reckoning becomes a rival audit.

activation_trace.role: Putting something in its proper station supplies the placement logic of the classification.
A written establishment that binds judgment supplies the authoritative record behind the comparison.
Knowledge that reaches the right result supplies the competence of the record's source.
Human reckoning becomes the competing calculation tested against the authoritative record.
Appointment to a status is the focus action newly read as recorded placement.

structural_cues: 45:2 places the book and divine wisdom together at the surah's opening, while 45:21 closes by condemning the compared people's judgment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies proper placement, binding inscription, and accurate wisdom; I infer that these form the institutional background of the focus classification. The live alternative is that the focus verb means simple making without a registry mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The focus contains an isolated moral calculation.
changed_reading.after: The calculation now competes with a binding, wisely ordered record: making the cohorts alike would be an official misclassification, not merely an implausible resemblance.

context_deltas.mechanism: Creation is measured, night and day succeed one another, dead land is revived, and winds are turned through states. This universalizes biological transition, so the focus cannot deny merely that both cohorts live and die; the denied equality must concern the quality, direction, or consequence of those shared phases.

activation_trace.role: Measured formation supplies an ordered rather than accidental life process.
Alternating succession supplies the temporal pattern into which living and dying can be placed.
Rain-born revival of land supplies a visible transition from death into productive life.
Unliving, unproductive land supplies a reversible material state rather than a terminal abstraction.
Turning from state to state supplies the transformation mechanism connecting the phases.
Life as benefit focuses the universal cycle into a question about differentiated moral yield.

structural_cues: 45:5 explicitly places revival after death inside a sequence of night, day, rain, land, and changing winds.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a reversible ecological cycle; I map that cycle analogically onto the focus pair and infer that bare biological occurrence is shared while moral quality need not be. The live alternative is that the ecology functions only as proof of resurrection.

changed_reading.before: The focus denies that the groups undergo the same biological endpoints.
changed_reading.after: Both groups plainly participate in created cycles of life and death; what is denied is a flattening of those phases' quality, direction, or realized consequence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sequence moves from truth being recited to hearing without compliance, tightening into persistence, taking signs as mockery, and relying on what was earned. Evil acquisition in the focus is therefore not generic misconduct; it includes a repeated way of handling disclosed evidence.

activation_trace.role: Following in sequence supplies sustained delivery of evidence rather than a single encounter.
Reality fixed against falsehood supplies the disclosed content being mishandled.
Hearing as understanding and compliance exposes the gap between acoustic reception and obedient reception.
Fixed persistence supplies the willful continuation after evidence has arrived.
Taking as an acquisition supplies an active appropriation and repurposing of the signs.
Mockery supplies the distorted use to which the acquired sign is put.
Sought and obtained gain supplies the nearby consequence-bearing vocabulary of acquisition.
Discrediting by speech lets the focus acquisition include hostile verbal treatment of evidence.

structural_cues: 45:6-10 forms a reception chain: recital, hearing, persistence, partial knowledge, mockery, and failed earnings.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ordered reception failures; I infer that they instantiate the focus's acquired evils and also corrupt the later judgment. The live alternative is that the focus refers to a wider, unspecified set of wrong acts.

changed_reading.before: The evil deeds are an unspecified moral inventory.
changed_reading.after: A central acquired evil is an evidence-handling habit: hear, understand enough to act, persist, repurpose as mockery, and then calculate from the distortion one has maintained.

context_deltas.mechanism: Believers are told to cover offenses in the present while recompense remains divine; the next ayah directs good toward the acting self and evil against it, then names return. The focus's non-equivalence is therefore compatible with present forgiveness and works through deferred, reflexive consequence rather than immediate social separation.

activation_trace.role: Covering an offense and shielding its bearer from its effect supplies present interpersonal restraint.
Returning an act with its consequence supplies the deferred divine differentiation.
The acting self in its own identity supplies the recipient of good and harmful consequence.
Return to a prior source supplies the temporal closure in which consequences are settled.
The contested parity is now constrained by forgiveness now and differentiation upon return.

structural_cues: 45:14 assigns forgiveness to believers and recompense to God; 45:15 then uses opposed reflexive directions before the plural return.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies present forgiveness, later recompense, reflexive syntax, and return; I infer that the focus is not a license for believers to enforce unequal worldly treatment. The live alternative is that the forgiveness command concerns a narrower class of injury.

changed_reading.before: Denying equality requires believers and wrongdoers to be visibly separated in present life.
changed_reading.after: Ultimate moral equivalence is denied while present forgiveness remains commanded; distinction can mature within each acting self and be disclosed upon return.

context_deltas.mechanism: Difference after knowledge, decisive judgment, placement on a disclosed way, repeated following, and desire as an alternate pull turn the focus comparison into a route model. A shared standard or point of access need not yield a shared trajectory or destination.

activation_trace.role: Each party taking a different road supplies divergence generated after disclosure.
A decisive ruling supplies the endpoint at which divergent routes are distinguished.
Placement into a condition repeats the focus verb and supplies the start of an authorized route.
An open water access supplies the material image of a disclosed life-giving way.
Matching or equality supplies a common measure without requiring identical outcomes.
Tracing an effect step by step supplies trajectory as the mechanism of moral formation.
The self's inclination supplies the competing directional pull.
A just, common position supplies equality of measure while preserving route-dependent distinction.

structural_cues: 45:17 locates disagreement after knowledge; 45:18 repeats follow and do-not-follow around two competing directions.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies divergence, a decisive ruling, an open source, following, and inclination; I infer a causal route from followed orientation to differentiated life and death. The live alternative is an institutional-law reading without spatial movement.

changed_reading.before: The two cohorts are static ranks receiving different awards.
changed_reading.after: They have access to a common measure but follow different routes; the verse denies that divergent trajectories can be assigned one life-course and destination.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding ayah offers inward sights, direction, mercy, and settled certainty. The focus then opens with supposition and ends with bad judgment, exposing not only a wrong verdict but a failed mode of seeing.

activation_trace.role: Inner sight supplies the faculty against which the focus calculation is diagnosed.
Gentle direction toward truth supplies the offered correction to the subjects' reasoning.
Compassion supplies the relational setting of the offered insight rather than a bare proof.
Stable knowledge with doubt removed supplies the epistemic opposite of the focus supposition.
Unsettled estimation marks the defective mode that follows the offer of certainty.
Right-reaching knowledge supplies the standard the condemned judgment fails to meet.

structural_cues: 45:20 is the immediate lead-in to the focus and moves from perceptual language to certainty before 45:21 moves from supposition to judgment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the epistemic sequence; I infer that 45:21 functions as a diagnostic exercise in seeing and judging. The live alternative is that 45:20 simply introduces revelation generally and the focus remains only eschatological.

changed_reading.before: The focus reports an incorrect belief about future justice.
changed_reading.after: The focus performs a present diagnosis: a person can be given inward sight yet continue to estimate with a faculty that cannot reach a sound judgment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The ayah after the focus grounds creation in measured truth so that every self receives what it acquired without misplacement. This specifies the rejected equality as inaccurate leveling and prevents the two-group contrast from becoming collective favoritism.

activation_trace.role: Measured formation supplies a calibrated cosmic basis for judgment.
Fixed correspondence with reality supplies the standard of the calibration.
Act-for-consequence return supplies the operative rule of differentiation.
Total inclusion supplies the rule's universal scope.
Each self in its own identity supplies the unit assessed within the two broad cohorts.
Self-obtained acquisition supplies the individual evidence being returned.
Putting a thing outside its proper place supplies the prohibited error in false leveling.
The proposed equality becomes the specific calibration tested by the following rule.

structural_cues: 45:22 follows the focus with a purpose construction and shifts from two plural cohorts to every singular self.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies immediate sequence, individual scope, acquisition, recompense, and non-misplacement; I infer that 45:22 specifies why the focus equality is bad judgment. The live alternative is that it gives a separate cosmological rationale rather than a direct gloss.

changed_reading.before: The focus contrasts two blocks and could sound like status-based preference.
changed_reading.after: The contrast is a shorthand for exact individual calibration: every self's own acquisition matters, and equalizing unlike records would itself put things out of place.

context_deltas.mechanism: Taking desire as an object of allegiance is followed by sealing hearing and heart and placing a cover over sight. The same making verb as the focus now operates on perception, activating a feedback loop in which acquired action forms the faculty that later makes the bad judgment.

activation_trace.role: Deliberate taking and acquisition supplies the initiating act of allegiance.
Inclination of the self supplies the internal object that directs the act.
A preventing seal supplies closure of the receptive apparatus.
The bodily seat of hearing supplies one formed site of reception.
The heart as inward center supplies the formed site of valuation.
Assignment to a condition repeats the focus action at the level of sight.
Inner sight supplies the judging capacity placed under obstruction.
An overlying cover supplies the material mechanism of obscured judgment.
Acquired action supplies the focus-side input to the perceptual feedback loop.

structural_cues: 45:23 orders taking desire, misdirection, sealing, and covering immediately after the focus's bad judgment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the initiating allegiance and the subsequent closures; I infer a feedback arrow from chosen orientation through formed perception to judgment. The materially live alternative is a purely punitive sealing that follows culpability without recursively shaping it.

changed_reading.before: Bad actions and bad judgment are separate items in the verse.
changed_reading.after: Acquired action can form the perceiving and valuing self, so the final bad judgment is both another act and an embodied consequence of the prior orientation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later speakers restrict reality to worldly life, dying, living, and extended time; the packet explicitly denies them knowledge and marks their claim as conjecture. The reply adds divine giving of life, causing death, and gathering, so the focus pair becomes the hinge between a closed and an expanded temporal ontology.

activation_trace.role: Animate worldly life supplies the closed horizon asserted by the speakers.
Loss of life supplies the terminal event inside that asserted horizon.
Extended time supplies the impersonal agent claimed to exhaust the life-death sequence.
Disclosure to a knower supplies the epistemic state explicitly absent from the claim.
Doubtful imagining supplies the actual warrant of the closed-horizon claim.
Life given by an agent replaces the speakers' self-contained cycle with authored animation.
Caused loss of life supplies an authored transition rather than time's autonomous destruction.
Gathering dispersed persons supplies the phase omitted by the closed life-death model.
Supposition in the focus anticipates the later conjectural warrant.

structural_cues: 45:24 states a worldly life-death sequence; 45:26 answers with divine life, death, and an additional gathering.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated roots, explicit conjecture, and the expanded reply; I infer that the focus's life-death equality anticipates this temporal dispute. The live alternative is that the focus primarily concerns phase quality and only secondarily resurrection.

changed_reading.before: The equality question is only about fair treatment of two moral classes.
changed_reading.after: The equality also rests on a time-horizon dispute: if death closes the account, the trajectories can look alike; once gathering is restored, their acquired differences remain actionable.

context_deltas.mechanism: Every community is brought low before its own register, and the register speaks by truthful indication because works were transcribed. The bad judgment in the focus is no longer answered by assertion alone; it is contradicted by preserved evidence.

activation_trace.role: A gathered community or kind supplies the collective units first seen as two cohorts in the focus.
Kneeling supplies the bodily posture of exposure before judgment.
Enrollment in a register supplies each community's accountable file.
An indicator that speaks through its evidence supplies the record's testimony.
Correspondence with reality supplies the testimony's reliability.
Copying a written form into a book supplies preservation of acts across time.
Purposive acts supply the content transcribed and later made evidentiary.
The human verdict in the focus becomes a claim tested in an evidentiary hearing.

structural_cues: 45:28 repeats every community and its book; 45:29 changes the book from an object possessed to testimony directed against its readers.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies communities, posture, registers, transcription, and truthful indication; I infer a courtroom mechanism that answers the focus judgment with evidence. The live alternative is a broader disclosure scene not limited to legal procedure.

changed_reading.before: The focus condemns a judgment without showing how it is tested.
changed_reading.after: The judgment enters an evidentiary scene: differentiated works persist in community-specific records and can testify against the proposed equivalence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exact believer, action, and repair pattern from the focus returns, but its outcome is entry into mercy and rescue. Conduct differentiates the cohort, yet the destination is a gracious relation and interior, not a wage exactly commensurate with entries.

structural_cues: 45:30 repeats all three markers of the focus's positive cohort and then names its outcome with spatial entry language.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the exact cohort recurrence and entry into compassion; I infer that mercy prevents the record model from becoming strict wage arithmetic. The live alternative is that mercy is simply the named form of recompense and remains fully ledger-like.

changed_reading.after: Records still distinguish trajectories, but the positive outcome is inclusion within mercy; non-equivalence is relational and gracious as well as forensic.

context_deltas.mechanism: The evils of action become visible and close around their agents; deceptive worldly life had made their consequences look otherwise, and the final state has no outward passage. The focus's acquired evils can therefore be read as constructing a latent environment that later appears, not merely as entries followed by an unrelated sentence.

structural_cues: In 45:33 the evils of what they did become the grammatical subject of appearance and enclosure.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies appearance, act-derived harm, enclosure, deception, and no exit; I infer that deeds mature into an inhabitable consequence. The live alternative is an externally imposed punishment represented as surrounding them.

changed_reading.before: God assigns a separate reward or punishment after deeds are counted.
changed_reading.after: The deeds may themselves remain latent until their harmful shape appears and encloses the agent; divine making can disclose and stabilize a self-produced condition.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates bodily branches beneath ordinary moral vocabulary: acquisition can carry cutting, evil can carry affliction, and later sealing and covering provide a body-scale mechanism. It remains anchored in the focus's action, evil, and judgment sequence and is strengthened by later perceptual closures and visible enclosure. Downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy for moral-perceptual formation, not as a claim that the focus lexically denotes wounds or disease.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus places acquired evil immediately upstream of a defective judgment, allowing the judging self to be tested as something injured or occluded by what it does.

changed_reading.before: Evil deeds are abstract infractions followed by an intellectual mistake.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, repeated evil behaves like an acquired lesion: it alters reception, deforms judgment, and eventually becomes visible as an enclosing condition.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because several economic and compensation branches are form-distant from the surface constructions. It remains valid as a focus-wide cluster of reckoning, acquisition, assigned return, worker's due, equivalence, and legal assessment, later activated by trading loss and copied records. Downstream prose should call it an audit or compensation analogy, not reduce the verse to a commercial transaction.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Nearly every major focus operation can occupy a valuation workflow: count, acquire, work, assign, equalize, and adjudicate.

changed_reading.before: The verse announces a broad moral difference.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it challenges a compensation audit that assigns equal value to unequal, actor-generated records and is therefore both mathematically and legally defective.

It remains anchored through the exact positive cohort's reappearance and explicit movement into an interior. Downstream prose should render it only as a generative spatial echo, not replace compassion with anatomy or claim a new birth doctrine.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus asks what condition the two cohorts will be made into across life and death; the later positive cohort is moved into a compassionate interior.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, their differentiated outcome can be imaged as entry into a protected, life-bearing interior where divine making is reformative rather than merely distributive.

strongest_changes: 45:22 turns the broad two-cohort contrast into truthful, non-misplacing assessment of every individual self and its own acquisitions.
45:24-26 makes the paired living and dying a dispute over temporal horizon: conjectural closure at death versus authored life, death, and gathering.
45:28-30 holds two mechanisms together without merging them: preserved records answer bad judgment, while the positive outcome is entry into mercy rather than bare wage arithmetic.
45:33-35 activates a latent-consequence reading in which acquired evils become visible, enclosing, and finally inescapable.
summary.what_was_special: The focus began as a simple denial of equality but sustained several mechanisms at once: official classification, calibrated valuation, ecological phase change, evidence handling, route formation, perceptual feedback, temporal horizon, speaking record, and gracious inclusion. The repeated roots around it sharpened these readings without forcing one final interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: The syntactic reach of equality remains live: phase-by-phase comparison of the two cohorts and a critique of flattening life and death are both plausible.
The context supports both intrinsic consequence, where deeds mature into condition, and externally assigned judgment; their exact causal relation is unresolved.
The ecological, lesion, audit, and generative-interior readings are branch-triggered analogies whose explanatory value is clearer than their lexical force.
Exact individual recompense and encompassing mercy coexist, but the packet does not reduce their relation to a single arithmetic model.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Deeds as wounds cut into a life.** `ج ر ح/B001` is cutting skin and producing a wound; `س و ء/B001` supplies ugly harmful acts. The packet sets those who "wound-acquire" evils against intentional sound action, then extends the contrast across life and death. I infer that acts alter the actor's lived surface and continuity; they are not detachable entries. The demand for equal outcomes is therefore a demand that unlike embodied histories leave no difference.
2. **Bad judgment fails to restrain corruption.** `ح ك م/B001` is restraint that turns back to set right, while `س و ي/B001` is equivalence. The packet supplies a proposed equivalence that would erase the distinction between corruption and soundness. I infer that such leveling disables judgment's corrective function. `ساء ما يحكمون` reads as a diagnosis of a ruling that cannot restrain because it refuses meaningful difference.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: The truthful creation and exact recompense of 45:22 immediately correct the proposed leveling, while 45:29 gives acts a record that preserves rather than erases their differences.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Their supposition is a defective accounting model.** Lexical anchors: counting/reckoning in `ح س ب B001`, reckoning as supposition in `ح س ب B002`, equality in `س و ي B001`, and restraining judgment that sets right in `ح ك م B001`. The packet supplies each self's matching acquisition in 45:22 and the life -> death -> gathering sequence in 45:26. I infer omitted consequences -> false equivalence. The question exposes a calculation that flattens distinct causal histories, not merely an emotionally unfair expectation.
2. **Acquired bad acts leave wounds that persist into judgment.** Lexical anchors: cutting skin/making a wound in `ج ر ح B001` and acquiring or committing an act in `ج ر ح B002`. The packet supplies rivalry as a spreading wound-image in 45:17 (`ب غ ي B004`) and repeats acquisition in 45:22 (`ك س ب B001`). I infer committed act -> incision in agent/social field -> durable trace. `ٱجْتَرَحُوا۟ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ` therefore makes wrongdoing materially consequential before any external sentence; equal treatment would ignore the formed lesion.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 45:22 supplied exact act-to-self recompense, and 45:26 restored the omitted gathering after life and death. Together they exposed `حَسِبَ` as a bad model with missing terms, while 45:22's `كَسَبَتْ` confirmed the acquired-act scope of `ج ر ح B002`.

baseline.text: Yoksa kötülük işleyenler, kendilerini inanıp iyi işler yapanlarla bir tutacağımızı, yaşamlarının ve ölümlerinin eşit olacağını mı sandılar? Ne kötü hüküm veriyorlar!

findings.text: Kötülük işlemek, failin hayatına ve toplumsal alana kalıcı iz bırakan bir yara açmaktır; eşit sonuç beklentisi birbirinden farklılaşmış bu geçmişleri yok sayar.
Onların sanısı, eylem ve sonuç arasındaki terimleri hesaptan çıkarıp farklı hayatları eşitleyen kusurlu bir hesaplama modelidir.
Bozukluk ile sağlamlığı eşitleyen bir hüküm, aralarındaki anlamlı farkı silerek hükmün düzeltici ve sınırlayıcı işlevini etkisiz bırakır.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Intended action creates an attributable entry that can be claimed, compared, judged, and reciprocally settled.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Wrongdoing is both acquisition and incision, equality is a disputed valuation, and the self is the legal identity to which the resulting account returns.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Incision Cannot Be Valued as Repair
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Harmful acts are cut into the account like wounds, then subjected to a false calculation that tries to equalize injury and repair.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: incision and wound (`quranic:root_000233:B001/m01`); deliberate acquisition of deeds (`quranic:root_000233:B002/m01`); counting and calculation (`quranic:root_000318:B001/m01`); unsupported assumption (`quranic:root_000318:B002/m01`); equalization of two sides (`quranic:root_000766:B001/m01`); adjudication between parties (`quranic:root_000348:B002/m01`); moral ugliness (`quranic:root_000755:B001/m01`); repair opposed to corruption (`quranic:root_000876:B001/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: `اجترحوا` keeps its surface sense of acquired deeds while activating the image of a cut. Calculation then attempts to price wound and repair as equal conditions, exposing the judgment as a category error rather than a mere unfavorable opinion.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Life persists through generation, vital embodiment, and regathering despite the claim that time merely extinguishes successive bodies.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The resurrection dispute is pressured by a full generative chain of lineage, womb, childbirth, parenthood, loss, arrival, and collection.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Time's Attrition Meets Regathering
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Extended time is imagined as a conquering force that stills and destroys living bodies, while a contrary agency gathers them from dispersal.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: time as conquering force (`quranic:root_000494:B001/m01`); extended duration (`quranic:root_000494:B002/m01`); loss of life and force (`quranic:root_001454:B001/m01`); stillness and extinguishment (`quranic:root_001454:B012/m01`); animate life (`quranic:root_000383:B003/m01`); life as preservation and benefit (`quranic:root_000383:B013/m01`); destruction and disappearance (`quranic:root_001596:B001/m01`); gathering dispersed members (`quranic:root_000259:B001/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The denial gives time an active role: it overpowers, stills, and erases. Gathering answers at the level of mechanism by reversing dispersal, while the life senses retain both animate force and preserved benefit.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Life persists through generation, vital embodiment, and regathering despite the claim that time merely extinguishes successive bodies.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The resurrection dispute is pressured by a full generative chain of lineage, womb, childbirth, parenthood, loss, arrival, and collection.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Womb, Lineage, and Fathers Form a Generative Chain
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Lineage is built through a womb, childbirth, paternal nurture, arrival, and loss; the demand for the fathers points back into this material chain.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: sons and transmitted lineage (`quranic:root_000156:B007/m01`); womb as the child's enclosure (`quranic:root_000552:B003/m01`); childbirth and the newborn (`quranic:root_001533:B005/m01`); fatherhood and nurture (`quranic:root_000007:B001/m01`); arrival into presence (`quranic:root_000009:B001/m01`); bringing or presenting another (`quranic:root_000009:B002/m01`); a parent's loss of a child (`quranic:root_001454:B005/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The lexical field renders ancestry as embodied production rather than an inert list of predecessors. Asking that fathers be brought back invokes arrival at the far end of a process whose earlier stages already include enclosing, birthing, nurturing, and bereavement.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi derinin yarılmasını, darbe ya da saplama sonucunda oluşan tek yarayı ve deride kalan kanlı izi birlikte bildirir. Bu nedenle dal hem yaralama eylemini hem de onun bedendeki sonucunu kapsar; kazanma ve sözle itibarsızlaştırma anlamları bu kimliğin parçası değildir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Kapsam bedensel yaralama ve oluşan yarayla sınırlıdır; kanama, kesme veya yaranın sonradan azması tek başına bu dalı tanımlamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Eylem, yara adı, çoğul ve yaralanmış kişi biçimleri dalın bedensel çekirdeğini verir; hayvanın verdiği zarara ilişkin kalıplaşmış söz yalnız kendi bağlamında geçerlidir.

concept_map.definition: Deriyi darbe, saplama ya da keskin bir araçla yararak bedensel bir yara oluşturmak ve bu eylemin deride bıraktığı, çoğu kez kanlı izdir.

facets.statement: Temel işlem derinin darbe, saplama veya keskin bir araçla yarılmasıdır.
İşlemin sonucu, deride oluşan tek yara ya da kanlı iz olarak da adlandırılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar deriyi yarma eyleminde ve bu eylemin darbe ya da saplamayla oluşan bedensel sonucu adlandırmasında birleşir; ad biçimleri tek yara ile yara topluluğunu da ayırır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bedensel yaralama eylemiyle onun deride bıraktığı yaranın birlikte temsil edilmesi gereken genel kullanım için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Deriyi yarma işlemini ve bunun bedendeki yara sonucunu birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin derisini darbe, saplama veya keskin araçla yarma eyleminin yüklem olarak anlatıldığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Bedensel yarayı meydana getiren işlemi eksiksiz korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Darbe veya saplamanın deride bıraktığı bedensel sonuç ad olarak anlatıldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Deride oluşan yara veya kanlı iz sonucunu korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: yara veya derideki kanlı yara izi

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal derinin yarılmasıyla eylem sonucundaki yarayı birlikte adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal yaralayıcı izin yanında yaralayıcı damgalamayı da kapsayabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da bedende yara açılmasını ve yaralanmış kişiyi anlatabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal bedendeki yaralayıcı iz çevresinde genişlerken odak dal deriyi yarma işlemi ile darbe veya saplamadan kalan yaranın adını özellikle birleştirir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal kanama olmasa da derinin yarılması ve oluşan yara üzerine kuruludur.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal yaranın kendisinden çok kanın çıkmasını veya çıkarılmasını öne alır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Bedensel bir darbe hem yara hem de kanama doğurabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Yara kanayabilir, ancak odak dalın çekirdeği deri bütünlüğünün bozulmasıdır; komşu dalın çekirdeği ise kanın dışarı çıkmasıdır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal ilk yaralama eylemini ve doğrudan oluşan yarayı kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal yaranın yeniden azmasını veya iyileşme sonrasında iz bırakmasını bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da aynı bedensel yaranın farklı evrelerine değinebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal yaranın oluşumunu adlandırır; komşu dal ise önceden oluşmuş yaranın sonraki seyri ya da kalıntısıyla sınırlıdır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal deri üzerinde yara oluşturma sonucunu gerektirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal nesneyi kesme, koparma veya ilişkileri kesme gibi daha geniş ayrılma işlemlerini kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Kesme işlemi bedende uygulandığında yara meydana getirebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Kesme yaranın olası aracıdır ama yara olmak zorunda değildir; odak dalı belirleyen şey derinin yaralanması ve bedensel yaranın oluşmasıdır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; kan, kesme, yaranın sonraki seyri ve en yakın bedensel yara karşılıkları sınırı açıklayan örnekler olarak seçildi, diğerleri yalnız uzak tema veya ayrı kök dallarıdır.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الجرح والجراحة والجراح والجروح وأثر الدم في الجلد وما يكون من ضربة أو طعنة أو حديدة
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه الكسب ولا الجوارح الصائدة ولا جرح الشاهد إلا من جهة التشبيه
branches.source_phrase_ar: شق الجلد (maqayis)؛ جرحته أجرحه جرحا واسمه الجرح والجراحة الواحدة من ضربة أو طعنة (ayn)؛ جرحت الرجل أجرحه جرحا والجمع الجراح والجروح (jamhara)؛ جرحه جرحا والاسم الجرح والجمع جروح والجراح جمع جراحة (sihah)؛ الجرح الفعل والجرح الاسم والجراحة الواحدة من طعنة أو ضربة (tahdhib)؛ الجرح أثر دام في الجلد يقال جرحه جرحا (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir işi yapıp kazanmayı, bunun iyilik veya kötülük olarak kişiye yazılmasını ve özel olarak günah edinmeyi aynı kazanım çekirdeğinde toplar. Beden üyeleri bu kazanımın araçları olarak adlandırılır; fiziksel yaralama bu dalın anlamına girmez.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal çalışma yoluyla edinmeyi anlatır; sırf amaçlı eylem, bedensel yaralama ve avcı hayvanın kendisi ayrı sınırlardadır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın eylem biçimleri çalışma ve kazanmayı taşır; kötülük kazanma, aile için geçim sağlama ve kazandıran beden üyeleri yalnız belirtilen yapılara bağlı alt görünümlerdir.

concept_map.definition: Bir iş yaparak onun sonucunu kendisi ya da başkası için kazanmak veya edinmektir. Kazanım iyilik ya da kötülük olabilir; beden üyeleri de insanın bu kazanımı gerçekleştirdiği araçlar olarak adlandırılabilir.

facets.statement: Çekirdek, bir iş yapma ile o iş üzerinden bir kazanım edinmeyi birbirine bağlar.
Kazanılan şey iyilik veya kötülük olabilir ve kullanım özellikle günah edinmeye daralabilir.
İnsanın beden üyeleri, onun adına iyilik ya da kötülük kazandıran iş görme araçları olarak anılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çekirdeği çalışma ile kazanmanın tek eylemde birleşmesidir. Bazı kullanımlar bu genel kazanımı günah edinmeye daraltır, bazıları da insanın iş gören beden üyelerini kazanımın aracı sayar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir eylemin yapılmasıyla onun iyi ya da kötü sonucunun kişi adına edinilmesini birlikte anlatan genel karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: İş yapma, kazanma ve kazanımın iyi veya kötü olabilmesi öğelerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Ahlaki yönün ayrıca belirtilmediği, çalışma ve edinmenin birlikte anlatıldığı eylem bağlamlarında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Bir işi yapma ile o işten kazanım edinme bağını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kazanımın özellikle kötü eylem veya günah olduğu ahlaki bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kötü eylemi yapma ve sonucunu kişinin kendi adına edinmesi öğelerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: İnsanın iyilik veya kötülük kazanmasına aracılık eden beden üyeleri topluca adlandırıldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Beden üyelerinin kişi adına iş gören kazanım araçları oluşunu korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: insanın iş gören ve kazanım sağlayan beden üyeleri

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal kazanımı iyi ya da kötü sonuç olarak kişiye bağlar ve kazandıran beden üyelerini de adlandırabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal her türlü çalışma, uğraş ve aile için çabayı daha geniş biçimde kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da bir iş yapmayı ve bu iş yoluyla kazanmayı anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal genel çalışma alanına yayılır; odak dal ise yapılan işin sonucunun kişi adına edinilmesi ve ahlaki kazanım olabilmesi bağıyla belirginleşir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal eylemin sonucunu kazanma veya kişinin hesabına edinme öğesini taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal kazanım sonucu aramadan canlı tarafından amaçlı yapılan her işi kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da kişinin bilinçli biçimde bir iş yapmasını anlatabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Her amaçlı iş bir kazanım sayılmaz; odak dalda iş ile edinilen sonuç arasındaki bağ kurucudur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal iyi veya kötü manevi sonucu edinmeyi de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal mal toplama, dünya veya geçim için çalışma ve aile uğruna çabayı öne çıkarır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da emek harcayarak kendisi veya ailesi için kazanmayı içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal maddi kazanım ve biriktirmeye daha yatkındır; odak dalın sınırı ise ahlaki sonuç dahil yapılan işin kişiye kazandırdığı her şeyi kapsar.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar karşılaştırıldı; çalışma, amaçlı eylem ve emekle kazanma adayları en yakın sınırları gösterir. Arınma, tembellik, bedensel yara ve aynı kökün diğer dalları yalnız karşıt tema veya uzak çağrışım düzeyindedir.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه جرح واجترح بمعنى عمل واكتسب واجتراح السيئات وكسب الجوارح للإنسان
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه الجرح الحسي ولا الصيد بالجوارح إذا أريد الحيوان الصائد نفسه
branches.source_phrase_ar: اجترح إذا عمل وكسب (maqayis)؛ واجترح عملا أي اكتسب (ayn)؛ يجترحن له الخير أو الشر أي يكتسب بهن (jamhara)؛ جرح واجترح أي اكتسب (sihah)؛ جرح واجترح إذا اكتسب (tahdhib)؛ الاجتراح اكتساب الإثم (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi av sahibi olan yırtıcı kuşları ve kara yırtıcılarını tek sınıf olarak tanımlar; eğitimli köpek ve pars da bu sınıfa girer. Adlandırmanın kazanma düşüncesiyle açıklanması sınıfın köken gerekçesidir, insanın beden üyeleri ya da genel kazanç anlamı değildir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal av yakalayan hayvan sınıfıdır; avın kendisi, av tuzağı, insanın beden üyeleri ve damızlık dişiler kapsam dışındadır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın tekil ve çoğul adlar av yakalayan kuş ve kara yırtıcılarını karşılar; avla ilgili başka kalıpların anlamı bu yalın dala taşınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Sahibi için av yakalayan, doğal olarak avcı ya da bu iş için eğitilmiş yırtıcı kuş ve kara hayvanıdır; köpek ve pars bu sınıfa girebilir.

facets.statement: Sınıf, av yakalama niteliğine sahip yırtıcı kuşları ve kara hayvanlarını kapsar.
Eğitilmiş köpek ve pars da sahibi için av yakalayan hayvanlar olarak bu sınıfa katılır.
Sınıfın adı, bu hayvanların sahipleri için av kazanması düşüncesiyle açıklanır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar av yakalayan kuşlar ile kara yırtıcılarını aynı sınıfta toplar; eğitimli köpek ve pars açık örneklerdir. Adlandırma ayrıca sahibine av kazandırma işleviyle ilişkilendirilir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Yırtıcı kuş, kara yırtıcısı, eğitimli köpek veya parsın av yakalama işleviyle sınıflandırıldığı genel kullanım için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Hayvan oluşu, yırtıcılık ve av yakalama işlevini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Av yakalayan kuşlar ve kara yırtıcıları bir topluluk olarak anıldığında kullanılan doğal çoğul karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Av yakalayan yırtıcı hayvanlar sınıfını çoğul biçimde korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal kuşları, kara yırtıcılarını, eğitimli köpekleri ve parsları av yakalama niteliğiyle açıkça sınırlar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu kart yalnız kazandıran hayvanlar adını verir ve avcılık sınırını açıkça belirtmez.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da sahibine av kazandırmasıyla adlandırılan hayvan sınıfına işaret eder.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Örtüşme güçlüdür, ancak komşu kartın kısa sınırı av hayvanı türlerini ve av yakalama koşulunu doğrulamaya yetmediği için tam eş anlamlılık kurulamaz.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal avı yakalayan canlı hayvanı adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal avın bir tuzağa takılıp kalması olayını anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her ikisi de avlanma sahnesinde avın ele geçirilmesiyle ilgilidir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal avcı hayvanın sınıfıdır; komşu dal ise avın tuzak içinde bulunduğu durumu anlatır ve hayvan sınıfıyla anlamca örtüşmez.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal eti veya avı elde eden yırtıcı hayvanı adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal avcı kuşa et verilmesini ya da av bakımından rızıklandırılmasını anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal avcı kuş, et ve av edinme çevresinde aynı sahneye katılır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Birinde referans av yakalayan hayvandır, diğerinde ise o hayvana et verme veya av nasip olma olayıdır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; kazandıran avcı sınıfı en yakın anlam adayıdır, tuzak ve besleme dalları ise yararlı tematik karşıtlardır. Kurt adları, kuş türleri ve aynı kökün öteki dalları sınıf sınırını daha fazla keskinleştirmez.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الجوارح من الطير والسباع والكلاب والفهود المعلمة وذوات الصيد
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه جوارح الإنسان ولا مطلق الكسب ولا إناث المال
branches.source_phrase_ar: الجوارح من الطير والسباع ذوات الصيد (maqayis)؛ الجوارح ذوات الصيد من السباع والطير (ayn)؛ سميت الطير والكلاب جوارح لأنها تجرح لأهلها أي تكسب لهم (jamhara)؛ الجوارح من السباع والطير ذوات الصيد (sihah)؛ الجوارح من الطير والسباع ذوات الصيد (tahdhib)؛ تسمى الصائدة من الكلاب والفهود والطيور جارحة (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi iki bağlı söz kullanımını bir araya getirir: bir tanığın güvenilirliğini kusur bularak düşürmek ve bir kişiyi dille sövmek. Ortak yön söz aracılığıyla kişiye zarar vermedir, fakat hukuki değerlendirme ile genel hakaret birbirinin yerine geçmez; dal bu iki yapı açıkça ayrılarak kullanılabilir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam yalnız tanığı kusur nedeniyle reddetme ve bir kişiyi sözle aşağılama yapılarında geçerlidir; yalın bedensel yaralama anlamına genellenmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal yalnız tanığın güvenilirliğini çürütme ve dille sövme kalıplarında sözlü zarar anlamı taşır; bu kapsam yalın kök anlamı gibi sunulamaz.

concept_map.definition: Belirli söz yapılarında, bir tanıkta güvenilirliğini düşüren kusur bulup sözünü reddetmek veya bir kişiyi dille sövüp itibarını incitmektir.

facets.statement: Tanık bağlamında yetkili kişinin bulduğu kusur, tanığın güvenilirliğini düşürür ve sözünün reddine yol açar.
Dil bağlamında bir kişiye kötü söz söylemek, sövmek veya onu sözle incitmek anlatılır.
Tanığı kusurlu sayma kullanımı, bedensel yaralamanın itibara aktarılan benzetmeli uzantısı olarak açıklanır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kanıt, sözün iki farklı zarar işlevini gösterir: tanığın güvenilirliğini kusur nedeniyle düşürüp beyanını reddetmek ve kişiyi dille sövmek. Hukuki kullanımın bedensel yaralamaya benzetilerek adlandırıldığı da belirtilir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Tanığın güvenilirliğini kusur bularak çürütme ile kişiyi dille sövüp incitme kullanımlarının ortak çekirdeğini vermek için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Sözlü kusurlama, tanıklığı reddetme ve kişisel itibarı incitme işlevlerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Tanıkta adalet veya güvenilirliği düşüren bir kusur bulunup beyanının reddedildiği değerlendirme bağlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kusur bulma, güvenilirliği düşürme ve tanığın sözünü reddetme sonucunu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin kötü söz veya sövgüyle doğrudan aşağılandığı kişiler arası bağlamda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Dil yoluyla sövme ve kişiyi sözle incitme eylemini korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal tanığın güvenilirliğini düşürüp beyanını reddetme gibi kurumsal bir sonucu da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal kişi, namus, inanç veya söz hakkında genel kötüleme ve kusur sokmaya yayılır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da söz yoluyla bir kişiye kusur yükleyip itibarını zedeler.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal genel kötüleme alanındadır; odak dalın ayırıcı kullanımı tanığın kabul edilebilirliğini düşüren değerlendirme ile belirli dil yoluyla sövme kalıplarıdır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal tanığın sözünü reddetmeye yol açan açık kusur değerlendirmesini kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal gizli söz, göz veya ağız işareti, gıybet ve kusur aramaya kadar uzanır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bir kişiyi kusurunu öne çıkararak sözle değersizleştirebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dalın gizli işaret ve gıybet kapsamı odak dalda yoktur; odak dalda ise tanıklığın reddi gibi belirli bir değerlendirme sonucu bulunur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal tek yönlü sövmenin yanında tanığın güvenilirliğini çürütmeyi de içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal karşılıklı sövüşmeyi ve dili sürekli kötü olan kişiyi özellikle adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da dil aracılığıyla hakaret etmeyi anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal sövüşme davranışı ve kötü dil alışkanlığı çevresindedir; odak dal ise belirli sövme eylemi ile tanık hakkında olumsuz hüküm vermeyi bir arada taşır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal kusurun doğru olup olmamasından bağımsız olarak tanığın güvenilirliğinin değerlendirilmesini kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal sözle suç atmayı ve özellikle ağır bir suçlamayı da içine alır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da söz aracılığıyla kişiye ayıp veya kusur yöneltebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal suç isnadına açılır; odak dal ise sövme ve tanığın kabulünü düşüren kusur tespitiyle sınırlıdır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; genel kötüleme, iğneleme, sövüşme ve sözlü suçlama en yakın ayrımları verir. İftira ve haksız suç yükleme dalları doğruluk koşulu bakımından daha dardır; aynı kökün öteki dalları yalnız tarihsel benzetme taşır.
